assume_current.subtitle: The mods showing
assume_current.body: Zenith can't tell which file you downloaded for these, so it can never say one is out of date. Marking them as current assumes each is the file that was newest on its GameBanana page on the day you added it.
assume_current.by_then: Uploaded by then: counts as the file you have
assume_current.after: Uploaded after: shows as an update
assume_current.untick_hint: Untick one to leave it asking
assume_current.left_undatable_single: {count} with no date added on record
assume_current.left_undatable_plural: {count} with no date added on record
assume_current.left_elsewhere_single: {count} whose base mod or patch file is still to be named in the tracking screen
assume_current.left_elsewhere_plural: {count} whose base mod or patch file is still to be named in the tracking screen
assume_current.proxy_caveat: Copied mods in from another folder? Their date added can be older than when you got them, so the first check may show an update for a file you already have. Say which file from its badge and it's settled for good.
assume_current.done_single: 1 mod now watches for files published after the day it was added.
assume_current.done_plural: {count} mods now watch for files published after the day each was added.

assume_current.already_done_single: That mod was already sorted out.
assume_current.already_done_plural: Those {count} mods were already sorted out.

bulk_resolve.title: Sort out where these mods came from
bulk_resolve.intro: To tell you about updates, the app needs to know which GameBanana page each mod folder came from and which file you installed. Ticked boxes are what this check worked out on its own — untick anything that looks wrong. Nothing you tick here is saved until you press Save.
bulk_resolve.section_identity: Is this the right mod page? ({count})
bulk_resolve.section_identity_why: These folders were linked to a page by reading a link somebody pasted, and nobody has checked it since. Compare the folder name with the page name — an update is only ever offered once you have confirmed it.
bulk_resolve.section_version_why: Knowing the mod isn't enough: a page usually offers several files, and without knowing yours the app can't tell a newer version from a different variant.
bulk_resolve.confirm_identity: Yes, this is the right mod page
bulk_resolve.excluded_untracked_single: 1 mod isn't linked to a GameBanana page
bulk_resolve.excluded_untracked_plural: {count} mods aren't linked to a GameBanana page
bulk_resolve.untracked_why: Each one is linked on its own, in its own dialog — a wrong match made in bulk could later overwrite a mod with a different mod's files. A mod you link here is saved straight away, not by Save.
bulk_resolve.untracked_resolved: Resolved and saved now — check again to see its updates.
bulk_resolve.untracked_marked_own: Marked as not from GameBanana — saved now.
bulk_resolve.already_known_single: 1 mod isn't listed: it's already sorted out, or you declared it your own.
bulk_resolve.already_known_plural: {count} mods aren't listed: they're already sorted out, or you declared them your own.
bulk_resolve.done_body: They'll be checked for updates from now on.
bulk_resolve.done_partial_body_single: Couldn't save it for 1 more — its folder may be read-only.
bulk_resolve.done_partial_body_plural: Couldn't save it for {count} more — those folders may be read-only.
bulk_resolve.already_done_single: That mod was already sorted out.
bulk_resolve.already_done_plural: Those {count} mods were already sorted out.
bulk_resolve.failed_single: One mod's folder may be read-only.

update.title: Updates — {mod}
update.verdict_patch_only: Only the patch is tracked here
update.verdict_patch_only_detail: This mod holds a patch plus the mod it patches, and update checking follows the patch. The patch has nothing newer — the mod itself isn't being watched.
update.verdict_version_unknown: Can't tell — no installed version on record
update.verdict_tracking_off: You marked this mod as your own
update.verdict_source_gone: The mod page is no longer available
update.verdict_indeterminate: The mod page listed no files
update.options_hint: This mod offers more than one file. We've marked the one we'd pick — you know which variant you installed, so check it before downloading.
update.baseline_value: No file recorded — anything published after {date} counts as an update.
update.no_successor: The file you installed is no longer offered, and nothing currently on the mod page is identifiably its replacement. Open the mod page to see what's there.
update.guess_caveat: Update checks are a best guess, not a guarantee — GameBanana publishes no comparable version numbers, so this rests on file labels and upload dates.
update.manual_note: “Update” downloads the file marked above and writes it over this mod's folder, keeping a copy of the current version first. Installing from the Marketplace instead adds a second mod folder alongside this one.
update.obsolete: The author has flagged this mod as superseded. It still exists and still downloads.
update.untracked_hint: Link this mod to a mod page first — use “Update tracking” from its right-click menu.
update.version_unknown_hint: Record which file you installed and this check can judge what comes back.
update.check_failed: Couldn't reach GameBanana. Check your connection and try again.
update.not_checked: This mod hasn't been checked yet.
update.siblings_single: {count} other mod came from the same archive as this one. Updating will offer it too.
update.siblings_plural: {count} other mods came from the same archive as this one. Updating will offer them too.
update.bulk_none_partial: No updates among the mods we could check
update.launch_checked_single: Checked 1 mod when the app started.
update.launch_checked_plural: Checked {count} mods when the app started.
update.patch_menu: What to do with this patch
update.dismissed: You're ignoring this update — the mark is gone from this mod's card. If the author publishes anything newer, it will show up again on its own.

reinstall.title: Reinstall {mod}?
reinstall.offline_body: The page for “{mod}” didn't load, so nothing was changed. Check your connection, then try again.
reinstall.unavailable_title: That version isn't on the page any more
reinstall.unavailable_body: GameBanana no longer offers the file “{mod}” was installed from, so it can't be put back. Check for updates to install the current version instead.

update_apply.title: Update {mod}?
update_apply.overwrite_note: Everything in this mod folder is replaced by the new version's files, so anything you added by hand goes with the old version and stays in the saved copy. The folder keeps its name, so it stays on or off exactly as it is now.
update_apply.snapshot_note: A copy of this mod as it is now is saved first. You can put it back from the mod's right-click menu.
update_apply.keybind_note: If you rebound any keys inside this mod's .ini, the file that comes with this download replaces them. The saved copy still has them.
update_apply.patch_unrecorded_note: This folder holds a patch as well, and nothing records which files came from it — so the update can't set it aside and put it back. The saved copy still has it.
update_apply.patch_warning: This download is a patch: it contains .ini files and none of the {count} file(s) they need, so it expects the mod it patches to already be in this folder. Only its .ini files are being replaced — everything else here is left as it is.
update_apply.unused_folders: The archive also contains {folders}, which isn't part of this mod and won't be installed.
update_apply.group_row_newer: has a newer file than this one — writing it would go back a version
update_apply.group_refused_not_base: {mod} — this download isn't what that folder is built on, so writing it there would put one mod's files where another's belong.
update_apply.group_refused_layout: {mod} — this archive's folders no longer match how that mod was installed, so which files are its can't be told.
update_apply.group_refused_collision: {mod} — two of your mods recorded the same folder from this archive, so which one it became can't be told.
update_apply.group_flattens: {mods} hold a patch and nothing records which files came from it, so the update can't set it aside and put it back. The saved copies still have it.
update_apply.group_patch_warning: This download is a patch and expects files it doesn't carry, so only part of {mods} is replaced.
update_apply.group_other_folders: {folders} in this archive won't be installed — none of them is a folder this write goes into.
update_apply.blocked_empty: The download contained no mod folders.
update_apply.blocked_unknown: This mod was installed before the app started recording how archives were unpacked, and this download contains more than one folder — so which one is this mod is something only you can say.
update_apply.blocked_changed: The archive's layout no longer matches how this mod was installed, so writing it over the folder could put files in the wrong place.
update_apply.blocked_refused: None of the mods this archive installed can take this download. What stopped each one is below.
update_apply.blocked_hint: Download it from the Marketplace instead and install it as a new mod, then remove the old one once you're happy with it.
update_apply.pick_intro_unknown: This mod was installed before the app started recording how archives were unpacked, and this download contains more than one folder. Tick the folders that make up this mod.
update_apply.pick_intro_changed: This archive's folders no longer match how this mod was installed. Tick the folders that make up this mod.
update_apply.effects_heading: What this does to the folder
update_apply.done_written_value: {count} file(s) copied into the mod folder
update_apply.done_restored_single: {count} of the mod's own files, where the patch no longer replaces it
update_apply.done_restored_plural: {count} of the mod's own files, where the patch no longer replaces them
update_apply.done_dropped_single: {count} file that isn't part of the new version was removed
update_apply.done_dropped_plural: {count} files that aren't part of the new version were removed
update_apply.done_reactivated: Switched off for the copy, then switched back on
update_apply.keybinds_explainer: The new version shipped its own .ini, which replaced the keys you had. Nothing was carried over — putting a key back automatically risks writing a broken .ini — so set them again with “Edit keybinds” in the mod's right-click menu, or restore the saved copy to get the old file back.
update_apply.rollback_hint: Not what you expected? “Restore a previous version…” in this mod's right-click menu puts it back exactly as it was.
update_apply.mod_missing_title: The mod is no longer there
update_apply.mod_missing: “{mod}” is no longer in your mods folder.
update_apply.snapshot_failed: Couldn't save a copy of “{mod}” first, so nothing was changed. Check that there's free space and that the app data folder is writable.
update_apply.copy_failed: Updating “{mod}” failed part-way: {message}. Restore the saved copy from its right-click menu, and close the game first if it's running.
update_apply.layout_failed: Couldn't work out where the new files go for “{mod}”.

backups.title: Previous versions of {mod}
backups.intro: Saved automatically before each update. Restoring puts the old files back and removes anything added to the folder since; a copy of the current state is saved first, so this can be undone.
backups.empty: There's nothing saved for this mod yet. A copy is saved automatically the first time you update it from inside the app.
backups.reason_patch_removal: before a patch was taken out
backups.confirm_body: “{mod}” will be put back to how it was on {date}: its files from then come back, and anything added to the folder since is removed, files you put there yourself included. A copy of it as it is right now is saved first, so you can undo this.
backups.undo_gone: The copy saved before the restore is no longer kept.

shader_fixes.restart_title: Restart the game to apply shader changes
shader_fixes.no_folder_body: {mod} stays off: there is no d3dx.ini in your ZZMI folder, so there is nowhere to put its shader files.
shader_fixes.no_folder_body_many: {mods} stay off: there is no d3dx.ini in your ZZMI folder, so there is nowhere to put their shader files.
shader_fixes.taken_body: {mod} stays off: {owner} already placed {files}, with contents that differ from this mod's copy.
shader_fixes.taken_unowned_body: {mod} stays off: ZZMI's shader folder already has {files}, with contents that differ from this mod's copy.
shader_fixes.taken_copy_body: {mod} stays off: another copy of {mod}, in a folder the app can't read, placed {files}, with contents that differ from this mod's copy.
shader_fixes.taken_still_on_body: {mod} stays off: the link {link} in ZZMI's Mods folder keeps another copy of it on, and that copy placed {files}, with contents that differ from this mod's copy.
shader_fixes.taken_link_title: A link is in the way
shader_fixes.taken_link_body: {mod} stays off: the way to {files} in ZZMI's shader folder goes through a link, and the app never writes through one.
shader_fixes.not_restored_body: {files}, from the other copy of {mod} at {folder}
shader_fixes.adopted_body_single: {mod} uses {count} file that was already in ZZMI's shader folder. It stays there when the mod is off.
shader_fixes.adopted_body_plural: {mod} uses {count} files that were already in ZZMI's shader folder. They stay there when the mod is off.
shader_fixes.adopted_many_single: {count} mod uses files that were already in ZZMI's shader folder. They stay there when the mod is off.
shader_fixes.adopted_many_plural: {count} mods use files that were already in ZZMI's shader folder. They stay there when the mods are off.

diagnostics.write_log_hint: Records what the app does — the mods it touches, the folders it writes to and the pages it fetches — so a problem can be looked into afterwards. Your username is removed and file paths are shortened. The last seven runs are kept.
diagnostics.open_folder_hint: One file per run, newest last. This is the one to attach to a bug report.
diagnostics.open_failed_body: Nothing has been written there yet, or the file manager didn't start.
diagnostics.copy_hint: Your system details and the most recent log lines, ready to paste into a bug report.
diagnostics.copied_body: Your system details and the most recent log lines are on the clipboard.

updates.check_on_launch_hint: Contacts GameBanana once at startup and marks mods that have a newer version published. Nothing is downloaded or installed — updates are always applied by you.

launch.umu_hint: Runs the game the way Steam does, which works more reliably. Needs umu-launcher installed.
launch.prefix_hint: The prefix the game is set up in. XXMI starts the game inside it.

launch.prefix_nested: This prefix has no pfx folder, so Proton started directly would make a new prefix inside it. Use a prefix made for Proton, or turn on umu-launcher.
launch.prefix_proton_only: This is a Proton prefix folder, with the prefix in its pfx folder. For Wine, choose that pfx folder.
